description: General teacher-editable starter Profile for curating explicit baseline and later evidence, optional supporting feedback, and a student comparison reflection.

family.description: Vitrine-owned general starter family for explicit evidence comparison over time.
family.label: Starter Improvement Portfolio

label: Starter Improvement Portfolio

requirements.statement: The Baseline Evidence section must contain exactly one explicitly curated item.
requirements.title: Baseline evidence

requirements.statement: The Later Evidence section must contain one to three explicitly curated items.
requirements.title: Later evidence

requirements.statement: The student interprets the exact curated baseline and later evidence without treating the Profile as proof that improvement occurred.
requirements.title: Student comparison reflection

requirements.statement: A teacher or authorized curator reviews the explicit evidence comparison before treating the Portfolio as ready for its intended use.
requirements.title: Teacher review

audience_rules.purpose: Student-facing review of explicitly curated improvement evidence. This audience rule is policy metadata only and is not source-read or disclosure authority.

known_limitations: This starter does not determine whether improvement occurred.
Evidence inclusion is an explicit curation decision.
Scores, ratings, attempts, dates, or revision numbers do not establish improvement automatically.
This starter is general Vitrine guidance, not school, district, state, regulatory, grading, or proficiency policy.
revision.label: Starter Improvement Portfolio

sections.label: Baseline Evidence
sections.purpose: One explicitly selected starting-point item used for later comparison. The section does not identify an earliest, lowest, or otherwise preferred source automatically.

sections.label: Later Evidence
sections.purpose: One or more explicitly selected later items that the student and teacher may compare with the baseline. Placement is explicit curation, not automatic latest, highest, or best selection.

sections.label: Supporting Feedback
sections.purpose: Optional explicitly selected student-facing feedback that helps contextualize the selected evidence when such feedback exists.

sections.label: Comparison Reflection
sections.purpose: Student-authored interpretation of the exact curated baseline and later evidence. The Profile does not calculate or assert improvement.
